On Jun 12, 2012, at 4:35 PM, nash <n3.n...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi,

I am trying to install rapache on Red Hat Enterprise. I have successfully done the following :

1)  Installed R-2.15 (from source) as a shared library with the flag set.
2)  Yum Installed httpd and httpd-devel for apache and apxs using rpm binaries. (httpd and apache2 seem to be same on redhat)
3)  Started the service and htttpd works fine. 
4) Next I installed rapache with path to R and apxs. I let the libapreq2 install. (Just unzipped it on the desktop and did the ./configure with the flags set). Compiled fine.
5) Next , 'make install' worked fine.

When ,
6) Executed 'make itest' to start rapache. This is the error I get :
make: *** [itest] Error 15

I included the line LoadModule R_module /modules/mod_R.so in the etc/httpd/httpd.conf . Restarted the service with just a warning. But make itest wont work. Now If I try to access localhost , it just hangs. I am a beginner at this not sure if the library paths are correct.

Would appreciate it if anyone can help me out with this.

Thanks,
nash
